method.cost: per-pixel mean squared RGB source difference at unchanged coordinates
method.optimizer: four independent minimum-error dynamic-programming paths with consecutive coordinate step -1,0,+1; intersect their four half-planes into a binary selection mask
method.claim: each side is independently minimum-error in its search band; not a globally optimal closed contour
method.tieBreak: argmin first match; predecessor -1,0,+1; smallest terminal coordinate on ties

left.value: local x, new selection on/right of this path

right.value: local x, new selection left of this path

top.value: local y, new selection on/below this path

bottom.value: local y, new selection above this path

trial2Row.role: candidate row with exact source-selected local repair

sourceSelectionMask.role: binary provenance, not game art; 255=new repair, 0=original crop

trial2AllBoundaries100pct.role: all selection boundaries with 64px context, unscaled

originalSameContext100pct.role: unaltered base at same comparison coordinates, unscaled

rectangleSameContext100pct.role: reconstructed trial1 rectangle at same coordinates, unscaled

trial2OriginalQaBox100pct.role: same coordinates as root trial1 seam inspection crop

right_upper_edge.role: unscaled comparison; left=original, right=trial2; no separator or drawn pixels

right_lower_edge.role: unscaled comparison; left=original, right=trial2; no separator or drawn pixels

limits: Optional material repair only, not structural or formal acceptance.
Boundary source-error metrics cannot certify visual geometry; inspect all-boundaries 100% crop.
Does not modify native images, assembler or progress.
